qualification.education_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. (Civil)/Planning, M.E./MTech. (Civil)/Planning, B.E./B.Tech. (Computer/IT/ICT/E&C), MCA/MBA(IT), Bachelors in Civil Engineering / Planning, Masters in Planning / Civil Engineering, M.com/MBA(Finance), B.com, B. Plan, Masters in Urban Planning
qualification.details: Dy. General Manager (Tech.): B.E./B.Tech. (Civil)/Planning with 15 years' experience or M.E./MTech. (Civil)/Planning with 12 years' experience. Dy. General Manager (IT): B.E./B.Tech. (Computer/IT/ICT/E&C) with 10 years experience or MCA/MBA(IT) or equivalent from a recognized University with 8 years' experience in E-Governance, IT Systems, Digital Transformation, IEC and Government Projects. Manager (Tech.): Bachelors in Civil Engineering / Planning and having 10 years of experience in relevant field Or Bachelors in Civil Engineering / Planning and Masters in Planning / Civil Engineering or equivalent from recognized University and having at least 8 years of relevant experience in water supply project/ sewerage, Road, Building, Energy / Greening / Planning / Heritage Infra / Transport & Mobility project etc. in Government Sector will be preferable. Dy. Manager (Tech.): Bachelors in Civil Engineering /Planning and having 8 years of experience in relevant field Or Bachelors in Civil Engineering / Planning and Masters in Planning / Civil Engineering or equivalent from recognized University and having 5 years of relevant experience in water supply project/ sewerage, Road, Building, Energy / Greening / Planning / Heritage Infra / Transport & Mobility project etc. in Government Sector will be preferable. Dy. Manager (Account): M.com/MBA(Finance) with 8 years of experience in similar field or B.com with 10 years of experience in similar field. Urban Planner: Bachelors in Civil Engineering / B. Tech (Civil) / B. Plan and Masters in Urban Planning or equivalent from recognized University and having 3 years of relevant experience. At least 2 years of experience in water supply project/ sewerage project in Government Sector will be preferable.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for GUDM Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.gudm.gujarat.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GUDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for Gujarat Urban Development Mission Recruitment 2026 is 21st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GUDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Gujarat Urban Development Mission has announced a total of 12 vacancies for various posts in its latest recruitment drive for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for GUDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for Gujarat Urban Development Mission Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the posts in GUDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary for the posts ranges from Rs. 55,000/- to Rs. 1,25,000/- per month, depending on the specific post and the candidate's qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for GUDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post, including degrees like B.E./B.Tech. (Civil)/Planning, M.E./MTech. (Civil)/Planning, MCA/MBA(IT), M.com/MBA(Finance), and Masters in Urban Planning.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for GUDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Gujarat Urban Development Mission Recruitment 2026 will involve an Interview and Document Verification. Candidates must clear both stages to be considered for the posts.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for GUDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) to apply for the Gujarat Urban Development Mission Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form for GUDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application form for Gujarat Urban Development Mission Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the official website of GUDM, which is www.gudm.gujarat.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the GUDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts announced under Gujarat Urban Development Mission Recruitment 2026 are on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms of the contract.
